title: testjig: i18n opt-in and end-to-end tests (language, Accept-Language, WS, pruning, preferredLanguages, problem details)
description:
jmap-testjig: opt in to i18n on all localizable families and add end-to-end tests over HTTP and WS:
- language view on /get, plus a /query sort
- Accept-Language does NOT alter /get data, but does localize problem-details title/detail
- the WS handshake Accept-Language applies to the whole connection
- stale-translation pruning from a client without i18n
- preferredLanguages is null on a shared account
- problem details on Session, eventsource, upload and download errors
Last child; depends on the rest.
notes:
2026-11-15: preferredLanguages was DROPPED from draft-atwood-jmap-updates-00 (working copy in jmap-chat-spec). The account value of urn:ietf:params:jmap:i18n is now {} like the Session value; the Account Language Preference section is gone (left to a future JMAP account-settings spec). Remove preferredLanguages from scope here.
Done 2026-11-15 for Mailbox, AddressBook (and Principal via the shared sharing backend) over HTTP and WS; the Calendar end-to-end case moves to JMAP-cayv.10 (blocked on JMAP-lehj). Dropped: preferredLanguages (removed from the draft) and upload/download problem cases (the jig has no upload/download resources; base-client tests cover the client side). Accept-Language is read by the jig's HTTP layer (CallerCtx is ()), not via JmapBackend::accept_language.
close_reason: testjig advertises i18n; localized problem titles with Content-Language; WS handshake Accept-Language per connection; 6 end-to-end tests over HTTP and WS. Calendar case moved to JMAP-cayv.10 (dependency removed).
